attempted_claim: Let H^n=C^n x R with Koranyi metric, Haar measure, homogeneous dimension Q=2n+2, X_1,...,X_{2n} horizontal fields, sub-Laplacian Delta_H, vector Riesz transform R=(R_1,...,R_{2n}), R_j=X_j(-Delta_H)^{-1/2}. Let sigma,w be locally finite doubling Borel measures on H^n with no common point masses. With A2 characteristic [sigma,w]_{A2}=sup_B sigma(B)w(B)/|B|^2 and Sawyer testing constants T^2=sup_B sigma(B)^{-1} int_B |R(1_B sigma)|^2 dw, (T*)^2=sup_B w(B)^{-1} int_B |R*(1_B w)|^2 dsigma over Koranyi balls B: is R(. sigma):L^2(sigma)->L^2(w) bounded iff [sigma,w]_{A2}+T^2+(T*)^2<infty, with norm equivalence ||R(. sigma)|| ~= ([sigma,w]_{A2}+T^2+(T*)^2)^{1/2} with no energy or weak-boundedness side condition (fix e.g. n=1)?
decisive_failure: The necessity direction is routine but was not developed into a standalone audited proof artifact. The sufficiency direction was not established and no counterexample was constructed. The numerical kernel probe is a finite-difference diagnostic, not a rigorous proof, and all conclusions about energy reversal rest on concrete computed evidence plus known structural obstructions rather than a full classification result.
